caseName: The Other Woman Was Never Danielle
title: Simone & Luca

questions.text:
He's in the shower. I've got maybe twenty minutes.
I just came off a twelve-hour night shift, so I'm too tired to be subtle about this.
He takes his calls out in the hallway and comes back smiling.
Who has he been calling the most lately?
questions.hint: In his Phone app, open Recents and see which name keeps coming up.

questions.text:
So she's his boss. Or close enough. I don't know which is worse.
A few weeks ago he went to Philadelphia for a three-day work conference. He swore the hotel was packed with sales reps and told me not to drive out. 😒
Where did he actually stay on the first night of the conference?
questions.hint: Find that trip in his Calendar, then check in Settings which Wi-Fi his phone joined on its first day.

questions.text:
That's not Philadelphia. That's not even close.
He always tells me the company pays for everything on the road: hotels, gas, steak dinners with surgeons.
How much did he pay out of his own pocket for his stay at that hotel?
questions.hint: In RevoBank's Current Account, find that hotel charge and check whether work ever paid him back.

questions.text:
So it wasn't the company's room. It was his.
A week or so ago his phone buzzed at 2 am. Next morning at eight sharp, he took a call in the hallway again.
All I caught was "I know you're done. Just give me a few more weeks." 😟
What is Danielle done doing for him?
questions.hint: Open his Messages thread with her and look for the late-night ones, not the work talk.

questions.text:
Covering for him? From who? Me? 😳
Not long ago I texted him Pierogi stuck in a cereal box, right in the middle of his work call.
He laughed and said his boss saw it and has a name for me now. He wouldn't tell me what.
What does Danielle call me when she talks to him about me?
questions.hint: Open WhatsApp and read his private chat with her, not the groups. She has a nickname for you.

questions.text:
Like I'm a client he's managing. 😤
During that conference he called me late and said he ate alone. Room service and spreadsheets, poor him.
Now I'm guessing that was a lie too. I bet he wasn't eating alone at all.
How many people were at his dinner table that night?
questions.hint: In Photos, look through the pictures from the conference trip and zoom in on any receipt.

questions.text:
That's not a work dinner. That's a family booth.
I keep telling myself it was a surgeon and his kids. I'm really good at telling myself things. 🥲
If he has kids, which school do they go to?
questions.hint: Go through his Mail Inbox and look for one sender that isn't work, travel or bills and keeps writing.

onboarding.text: I just got off a twelve-hour night shift in the ICU. I'm good in a crisis. Somebody codes, I don't panic. But this one is mine, and I can't think straight.
onboarding.label: Simone

onboarding.text: Luca and I have been together a year. Ramen on our first date, Penguins games on my couch, Pierogi asleep on his chest. When he's here, it feels like the easiest thing in the world.
onboarding.label: Simone & Luca

onboarding.text: Luca Ferrante sells surgical equipment. Two weeks a month he's on the road, takes his calls in the hallway, and lately a coworker named Danielle keeps texting him at 2 am.
onboarding.label: Luca

onboarding.text: He's in the shower and his phone is on my counter. I have maybe twenty minutes. I don't want to be the crazy girlfriend. I just want the truth. Help me look.
onboarding.label: Simone

Hey, it's Luca from the ramen place. I think you left your scarf. Also I'm still thinking about that broth.

You called it stealing. I'm on nights this week, ICU. Second date after sleep?

Pierogi knocked a glass off the counter again. Vitals stable, glass is not.
Tell Pierogi I'm sorry for whatever I did. 😂

Heading to a shift. Don't let Pierogi eat the plant.
No promises. She's staring at it now.
Philly summit starts tomorrow, three days. Hotel's packed with reps, so don't bother driving out, you'd never even see me.

Sorry I called so late last night. Room service and spreadsheets, that was my whole weekend.
It's fine. I was up anyway. Come home soon.
Back in Pittsburgh tomorrow. Missing you.
Pierogi missed you too. I guess I did too. ❤️
Off at 7:30. Want breakfast?
Yes. I'll grab the good coffee.
You still have that ladder I lent you?
It's in my garage. I'll drop it off this weekend.
No rush, just need it for the gutters.
Want me to help? I'm decent on a ladder.
Only if you bring the good coffee.
Deal.

Your fantasy team has never depended on anything but luck.
Cold. 😂
Truck passed inspection finally. Cost me three hundred bucks for a sensor.
That's what you get for buying a used truck from a guy named Skip.
Skip was a good guy.
Skip sold you a truck with a sticker on the dash that said 'check engine' in permanent marker.
Okay that's fair.
You at Mamma's Sunday?
Yep. You bringing the cannoli
From Pasquale's, yeah
My guy at the shop says Pop's brakes are gone. I told him to just do it and bill me
You're a good son Tony. Split it with me
Nah I got it. You buy the wine Sunday
Deal
Yo, you still got the extension ladder?
It's in my garage. What are you cleaning, the gutters?
Yeah, the storm last week filled them with branches
Come get it whenever. Door code is on the garage keypad, you know it
Thanks. I'll bring it back with a six pack
Make it a twelve
Ladder's back in your garage. Thanks man 👍
Saw the beer. You're a good man
Dinner at Ma's this weekend. You coming?
Planning on it. I'll bring wine.
Bring two, Pop drinks one himself.
Two it is.
See you there.

Which noise? The grinding or the squeal?
The squeal. Brakes probably.
Take it to Sal's cousin on Main. He'll do it fair.
Dad won't go anywhere he didn't know in 1985.
I'll talk to him Sunday.
Good luck. He listens to you more than me.
Only because I'm the youngest-looking one.
Lol you're not even the youngest
Don't tell Nico I said that.
Pop's truck is making that noise again. Can you look at it Saturday?
I'm not a mechanic Tony. I sell staplers for surgery
You're still better with a wrench than me
Fine. Bring the good flashlight
On it
Fantasy draft, I'm warning you now, I'm taking your first pick

Oh it's on 😂
Birthday party for Dad's friend Sal next month, you in?
Put me down. I'll bring the cannoli from the good place.
Fantasy draft is Thursday 8 PM. Don't be late again.

Me. Obviously.

I'll flag them. Can you retake the photos?

Got them, approved. Thank you! 👍

I'm in Wilkes-Barre all day. Save me a corner piece.
No promises. Those corner pieces go fast.

It should be in the shared drive under Contracts. Look for the file with 'rev C' in the name.
Found it. Sending now.
Thanks Linda, you're a lifesaver.
Reminder: compliance module is due in the training portal by the end of the month. It's the one about gifts and hospitality limits.
Ugh. How long is it?
About thirty minutes plus the quiz. Do it on a slow day.

They already did. Booked it for next week.

Yes please, fifty more. Same design.

Got it. Do I need slides?

Thanks, appreciate the fast turnaround
Did you finish the compliance quiz? Portal still shows you at sixty percent.
Doing it in the parking lot right now, I swear.
I'll believe it when I see the green checkmark 😄

Please confirm if you need a sample case shipped to the Allentown account.
Yes, two cases of the laparoscopic trainers. Rush if possible
Shipping tomorrow. Tracking number will be emailed.
Office closed Monday for the building's fire inspection. Work remotely.
Understood
Thank you! Last thing, the quarterly sales meeting is booked for the middle of next month. Calendar invite coming.
Got it, I'll accept it when it lands.
Reminder to update your CRM notes before Friday's pipeline review.
Will do tonight
Thank you! Also, company picnic RSVP closes tomorrow.

We're short on the 60mm reloads for Thursday's list. Can you check what you have in the trunk?
I've got six boxes of the blue and three of the green. I can swing by after lunch.
Perfect. Dock entrance, not the main lobby. Security gets weird.
Copy. Dock. I'll text when I'm in the lot.
In the lot, silver Malibu
Coming down now
Thank you!! You saved my Thursday.
Anytime. Tell the surgeons the coffee's on me next time.
Lol they'll hold you to that
Hey Luca, the OR is running late so the in-service might slip an hour. Okay with you?
No problem. I'll wait in the cafeteria and review the paperwork.
Thanks. Cafeteria has fresh pretzels today, just saying.
Now you're speaking my language 🥨
We're ready. Third floor, room six.
On my way up with the demo cart.
The team loved the in-service. Can you leave extra instruction cards at the desk?
Dropped off a stack of twenty. Let me know if you need more.
Perfect. We're good.
Morning. Do you do in-services for the new scrub techs? We have three starting the 15th.
Absolutely. Lunch-and-learn works best, people actually show up if there's food.
Ha. Pizza budget is a thing I can do.
How long do you need? I'd say 45 minutes plus hands-on with the demo units.
Perfect. Tuesday the 23rd at noon?
Booked. I'll put it on my calendar and send the sign-in sheet.
Running 10 min behind, parking garage is a zoo
No worries, we're setting up chairs
That went really well. Two of the techs already asked about the articulating handle.
Good. Tell them I'll leave the demo guide at the desk.
Hey, the value analysis committee wants the pricing sheet before the next meeting

Found it. Thanks!

Told you.

Core storage is fine. I'll check counts when I get in at 6:30

Got them in the trunk. Will bring both
You're a lifesaver. Coffee on me tomorrow
Cafeteria coffee doesn't count as a favor 😂
Value analysis meeting got moved to the following week. Heads up.
Dr. Monroe wants to try the new linear cutter next week. Can you be there?
What day? Let me check.
Wednesday, first case at 7:30
I'll be there at 7. Coffee for the team?
You're a hero

Sure. Thirty minutes enough?
Yes. Lunchtime so they actually show up
I'll bring pizza. Nobody ignores pizza
Genius. Conference room B is booked for you
Case went fine. Thanks for being there.
Of course. Send me the lot numbers when you have a sec for the paperwork.
Will do tonight
Count came out short by two cartridges. Want me to log it?
Yes please, I'll reconcile with the invoice this afternoon
Draft is Sunday night. You still in for the league this year?
Always in. Don't put me in the same division as Nico again, he cheats
He doesn't cheat, he just has no shame 😂
Same thing
Entry fee is still 50. Venmo me whenever
Sent. Check it
Got it, you're official
My daughter's soccer team needs a sponsor. Your company ever do local stuff?
Not usually, but I can chip in personally. What do you need?
Just a hundred for the jerseys. Your name goes on the back.
Sure. Send me the Venmo.
Sent. You're a legend.
Paid. Tell the kid to score one for me.
Did you see they signed that corner from Ohio State
Saw it. Finally somebody who can cover
Dude we've been saying that since 2019
And we'll say it again next year
Running club 5K Saturday, you coming or are you on the road
Road. Hospital in Harrisburg all week. Next one for sure
You say that every time lol
I mean it this time. Put me down
Pizza at my place after the Fourth if you're around. Kids can run around in the yard
What can I bring
Beer. Not that light garbage
Understood 🍺
Great time yesterday. Marco's got an arm, I'm telling you
He gets it from his mother, not me
Ha. Your brisket was good though
Zia's recipe. Don't tell her I gave it out
She scored twice today! Jerseys look great.
Love that. Send a pic if you have one.
Will do. Grabbing food after, want to join?
Can't, stuck in traffic on 81. Next time.
Yo you around for the preseason game? I got an extra ticket
Depends on the schedule. Let me check the calendar and get back to you
No rush, I got till next week
I'm going to have to pass, sorry man. Work thing
All good. I'll take my cousin
Penguins schedule just dropped. Opening week looks rough
I'll look tonight. Any home games on a weekend?
Three in October. I can try to get tickets through my cousin
Do it. Get two for the Saturday game
Done deal. Hockey season, baby 🏒
Fantasy mock draft is up, I'm giving you the 7 spot
Seven is fine. Just not last again
Lol you got last because you drafted a kicker in round 5
He was GOOD
He was a kicker
You still using that grill smoker for the cookout?
Yup, brisket low and slow. Twelve hours
I'll bring potato salad. Gina's recipe
Perfect. Bring the kids, I got a little pool
They'll never leave then

Good call

Always a hospital thing. Hospitals can wait one hour for sauce.

I'll call him tonight and push him. Do you have the orthopedist's number?
I put it on the fridge. I'll send you a photo of it.
Thanks Ma. Love you.
Love you more. Say hi to the little ones.
Saint Anthony's feast is next month. You coming to the procession? Your father wants to walk this year.
I'll do my best. Is the knee okay for that?
He says yes. He says a lot of things.
Ha. Save me a seat at the table after.
Marco asked me for a cannoli recipe. A nine year old with a cannoli recipe!
He wants to be a chef this month. Last month it was an astronaut.
Good, a chef feeds people. Come this weekend if you can.
I'll let you know. Love you Ma.
Luca, did you eat? I'm making meatballs Sunday
I'll be there Ma. Pop already told me about the gravy
He tells you everything before I can
Luca, did you eat today? You work too much
Yes Ma, I had a sandwich between meetings
A sandwich is not a meal. Sunday you come for dinner. I make the gravy
I'll try Ma. Might be on the road
Always the road. The kids ask for Nonna's meatballs
Ok ok. I'll bring the kids Sunday for sure

In the funnel cake. I remember 😂

God bless. I save you a plate of cookies

Always on the road. You'll get thin.
I eat plenty. Drive-thru is a food group.
Don't joke about that. Bring the children, they miss their nonna.
I'll tell Gina to bring them if I can't make it.

I light a candle for you every week. Eat something green.

They're not ready yet, Ma. Another week.
Tell them to hurry

Good boy. Love you. Eat something.
Love you too, Ma ❤️
Marco says thanks for the birthday card with the five dollars

Call me when you can, nothing wrong, I just want to hear your voice
Calling you tomorrow morning on my drive, Ma. Love you
❤️ Be careful on the turnpike
Always
Luca! Dave Kowalski from the Harrisburg rep group. You ready for the regional meeting?
Dave, hey. Ready as I'll ever be. Who's running it?
Corporate sends someone from marketing. Prepare for slides about synergy.
I'll bring snacks and low expectations.
Smart man

It could've been nothing at all
Question, which hospital system is giving you trouble on contracts? Mine are all stuck.
Susquehanna's materials office is the slow one. Everything goes through a committee.
Same story here. Is there a trick?
Find the person who actually does the paperwork and be nice to them. Bring donuts.
Donuts. Written on my hand.
Did you get the invite to the hospital charity run? They want sales reps to sponsor mile markers.
Saw it. Veridan might sponsor one, I'm asking around.
Cool. I'll put you down as a maybe.
Quick one, do you have a spare demo handle I can borrow? Mine got stuck in a locker.
I've got one. I'll be in Harrisburg Thursday. Meet me at the diner by the exit?
The one with the pie? Yes.
The pie is the whole reason.
Need a recommendation for a kids' summer camp for my nephew. Anything near Scranton?
Marco loved the nature camp at the state park. Counselors were great.
Perfect, I'll look it up.
Thanks for the handle. Coconut cream was excellent.
Told you.
Signed him up. He's already asking if there are snakes.
There are. And a guy named Gary who handles them like a pro.
Did you hear they're changing the commission structure next quarter?
I heard a rumor. Don't believe anything until it's in writing.
Fair. I'm updating my resume anyway. Just kidding. Kind of.
Ha. We all are.
Heads up, the Lehigh account is asking about you. Dr. Osei likes you more than me.
He likes anyone who shows up on time.
That explains why he doesn't like me
Golf outing in August. You in?
I'll try. I'm terrible. I'll drive the cart.
You're the best kind of golfer. The one who buys the beer.
Beer tomorrow night? I need to vent about the printer at work.
Printers are the devil. I'm in, text me the place.
Same place as usual. Seven-ish.
See you there.
Thanks for the ride home. Next round is mine.
Anytime. Drink some water.
Yes dad.
Golf Sunday? Tee time at Elmhurst, eight sharp
If I'm home, yes. Don't tell me the score of the last time
112 and you lost two balls in the creek 😂
The creek moved
Bringing my new driver. Prepare to be humbled
That driver cost more than my car payment. Just saying
Worth every penny. I hit one 250 yards. Once
Once is a start. Next time I'll bring the camera
Grab lunch after? The place with the big pretzels
Always. I'm starving by the back nine
Sign-up sheet is going around. I put you down for the Saturday group.
Fine. What's the entry?
60 bucks, includes lunch.
I'll Venmo you
Got it. Hey, safe travels this week.
You too, brother
My daughter has a soccer tournament next weekend, no golf. You free the one after?
Probably. Check with me midweek
Will do. Bring sunscreen this time
Luca, Dr. Osei here. Can you come by the OR suite to walk my team through the new stapler handle?
Of course, Doctor. What does your schedule look like next week?
I operate in the mornings. Anytime after noon is clear.
I can be there at one in the afternoon the day after tomorrow. I'll bring the demo unit and the instruction cards.
